name: get_editor_url
description: Return the targeted ChatCut project's web-editor URL. This session controls ChatCut Desktop, and the web editor is a separate surface of the same account: project structure syncs, and web-uploaded or generated media plays on both (Desktop downloads a compressed copy), but media imported locally in Desktop never uploads — the web editor shows it only as 'relink' placeholders, so a browser view of desktop-imported footage is rarely what the user needs. Meant for an explicit user request, with the user first told how the two surfaces differ and still wanting the link; never hand-build project URLs. Pass openPricing=true when the user needs billing, plan, or credit recovery; the returned URL opens the same project with ChatCut's pricing dialog.

editorBaseUrl.description: Editor origin/base URL. Defaults to CHATCUT_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5173.

openPricing.description: Open the ChatCut pricing/upgrade dialog on the returned editor URL.

pricingSource.description: Optional analytics source used when openPricing=true, e.g. external_mcp_insufficient_credits.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.
